content.text: {"name":"flow_V04_minus_V06_stock_spread","hypothesis":"Groups whose flow rate V04 has risen over 3 months relative to their own 60-month history, while the stock rate V06 is comparatively low cross-sectionally, earn lower next-month returns. The spread of V06 and V04 should rank-correlate positively with future returns.","falsified_if":"Mean rank IC is nonpositive, HAC t-statistic is below 1.5, or the top-minus-bottom tercile spread is not positive.","expression":"spread(tsz(chg(V06,3),60),tsz(chg(V04,3),60))"}
